expected.fmt:
interface Counter:
    var def bump(by: Int) -> Int

type Cell[T]:
    total: Int

impl Counter for Cell[T]:
    var def bump(by: Int) -> Int:
        self.total += by
        return self.total

def probe() -> Int:
    var cell = Cell[String](0)
    var i = 0

    while i < 1000:
        cell.bump(1)
        i += 1

    return cell.total
